in_sanskrit.name: Play
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है To engage in activity for enjoyment and recreation
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Play एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The act of participating in an activity for enjoyment and recreation. It implies a sense of enjoyment, freedom, and creativity. Play can be a physical activity, such as a game or sport, or a mental activity, such as reading or playing an instrument.
